svg.title: Proof. If the product vanishes both sides vanish, and no permission identity is used for a vanishing factor. Otherwise each factor is nonzero and (AB9) gives Ji = Pi∩Fθ(U). On a sealed family the full selector equals one exactly when no flag lies outside S i Pi, that is when Fθ(U) = S i(Pi ∩Fθ(U)) = S i Ji. Sealing is the disjointness of supports.
